title: The Mere That Keeps
introNarration: Sile taps the mere with a reed and does not drink. "Examine the still water. If the light squares up, defeat it. Then talk sile. It keeps voices. I want the water back."
reminderNarration: "Examine the still water. Defeat the reed-wisp if it is on the mere. Then talk sile. Type north from the Mist Lane."
completionNarration: The mere shows sky again. Sile sets a short reed-cloak on your shoulders. "Kern is east, past the stones, in the lintel field. Talk kern. He counts scratches. I count reeds. Neither of us is the barrow."

objectives.label: Examine the Still Water at Reed Mere. Type north from the Mist Lane.
Defeat the Reed Wisp at Reed Mere.
